nodes.label: CPD Frontend Design Exploration
nodes.rationale: Exploratory design study in parallel with the backend build; no repo frontend touched, the freeze holds; deliverable is a published mockup artifact feeding the M2 unfreeze scope.

nodes.label: Practitioner CPD Ledger surface (lead)
nodes.rationale: Compliance-cycle-first: cycle progress ring + category-threshold bars + verified-vs-self-reported banner, then the append-only ledger; beats the competitor's no-deadline weakness. Cycle-with-deadline is the unit of meaning, not cumulative total.

nodes.label: Organiser Accreditation & Compliance surface
nodes.rationale: Event-accreditation-centric, enriched with the forms' category/threshold vocabulary; roster eligibility as a stacked meter - eligibility is a property of the row, not a report you run.

nodes.label: Event Schedule single + multi-track
nodes.rationale: Multi-track needs sessions with start/end times, parallel tracks/rooms, and role-typed people - a richer schema than the current single-track agenda-block model; a data-model decision to make deliberately before building toward it (CLAUDE.md rule 13).

nodes.label: Practitioner wallet / QR pass
nodes.rationale: The mobile attendee surface; the personal QR turns registered into a first-party attendance fact when scanned; points show pending on the pass then posted in the ledger the moment check-in happens. QR rendered white-always (scannable regardless of theme).

nodes.label: Landing page
nodes.rationale: White-ground marketing surface; comparison strip is the competitor research verbatim (self-report to 30-day verification vs scan to real-time hash-chained); honesty guardrails - rule-aware for 8 bodies means encoded rulebooks, not endorsements; no invented client counts.

nodes.label: Palette: white ground + blue ramp
nodes.rationale: v3 (2026-07-16) locked one blue ramp with fixed roles (#1C3C94 primary, #0E79EC links/CTA, #4494BC icons/borders, #6CAAEF hover) replacing teal; status colours stay semantic; Eventar surfaces load white for everyone, dark is an explicit user choice never an OS/host inheritance.

nodes.label: App-shell architecture (global shell, pages swap)
nodes.rationale: Shell renders once with pages swapping inside it (URL updates, shell never moves); venue status indicator (Connected/Offline/Syncing) as a first-class shell element since offline tolerance is the #1 live-ops risk.

nodes.label: Provenance chip (scanned at venue / self-reported)
nodes.rationale: One of the two product-spine primitives (with the eligibility flag) missing from the minimum set; repeats across roster/ledger/wallet/check-in; first-party scanned-at-venue provenance is the one thing the incumbent structurally cannot show.

nodes.label: Landing aesthetic Option D White stage
nodes.rationale: Ivan's between B & C, white as the main color; B's white ground + glass nav + soft washes carrying C's drama on white (masked dot-matrix, bold-sans + serif-italic headline, dark-bezel laptop frame); candidate for the aesthetic lock.

nodes.label: Frontend freeze (holds until M2 review)
nodes.rationale: These mockups are a design target, not shippable code; the unfreeze build translates them onto the real token grid honouring the shipped component API.
